scope_note: South Indian Ocean Current naming context at 80 E near 40 S, east of the Agulhas Return naming transition and west of the 90 E split. Near-surface peaks cannot inherit historical upper-1000 m transport identity; ACC, north subtropical front and eddy attribution remain unresolved. Local monthly-mean component spans, not flow-normal widths, whole-current dimensions or a seasonal footprint.
layer: Satellite-derived near-surface product with nominal 15 m coordinate; not a direct 15 m instrument section or depth-resolved velocity.
time_convention: 72 nominal five-day 2013 archive samples, with four six-day gaps, January 1 through December 26. One year, not climatology or adequate evidence for annual extrema.
